name: TUGA Innovations, Inc.
summary: TUGA Innovations, Inc. is a burgeoning enterprise focused on electric vehicles, dedicated to the ideation, engineering, and manufacturing of unique automotive solutions. Its primary endeavor involves the creation of an innovative three-wheeled, all-electric vehicle, seating two passengers in a tandem configuration. This novel vehicle is being developed with a view to supplying a broad spectrum of clients, from public sector bodies like local governments and transportation network operators, to private entities such as vehicle-sharing platforms and logistics firms. Established in 2020, the company's central operations are based out of Vancouver, Canada.
